tagline: Global satellite communications provider connecting people, organizations and assets from anywhere
hero_kpi_rationale: The number of billable subscribers is a key indicator of the company's growth and market penetration in satellite communications, reflecting global demand for reliable mobile communications services in areas not covered by terrestrial networks.

kpis.name: Billable Subscribers
kpis.explanation: Number of subscribers paying for the company's services
kpis.description: The company had approximately 2.5 million billable subscribers worldwide as of December 31, 2025, an increase of 77,000 or 3% compared to 2.46 million as of December 31, 2024

kpis.name: Service Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the company's services
kpis.description: Service revenue represented 73% of total revenue for the year ended December 31, 2025 and 74% for the year ended December 31, 2024

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.description: Voice and data, IoT data and broadband service revenues have historically generated higher margins than subscriber equipment revenue

risks.title: Cyberattacks
risks.score_rationale: The company explicitly identifies cyberattacks as a major risk, with a dedicated governance structure including a chief information officer, an information security director, and an executive-level security risk management committee.

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company notes increasing competition from other satellite service providers, including SpaceX with its announced plans for global D2D services, as well as competition from terrestrial cellular systems.

risks.title: Technology Dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly dependent on its constellation of 66 LEO satellites and ground infrastructure, as well as its ability to maintain satellite health, capacity, and control.

risks.title: Geopolitical Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company operates globally, including in regions affected by geopolitical conflicts or natural disasters that could disrupt terrestrial telecommunications.

risks.title: Supply Chain Dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company relies on a global supply chain for components, including sole-source suppliers for most subscriber equipment and certain components, creating vulnerability to supply disruptions.

risks.title: Financial Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company depends on generating internal cash flow to repay debt and has significant government customers, including U.S. government agencies, for a substantial portion of its revenue.

ai_positioning.summary: Iridium Communications Inc. (IRDM) has no significant mentions of artificial intelligence or machine learning in the provided excerpts from its 10-K/20-F filings. Its core business focuses on providing global satellite communications services and positioning, navigation, and timing (PNT) services, particularly following the acquisition of Satelles in 2024.
